stages = {"source", "optimized", "validated", "shipped", "rejected"};
events = {"optimize", "validate", "ship", "reject"};
transition[stage_, event_] := Switch[{stage, event},
  {"source", "optimize"}, "optimized",
  {"optimized", "validate"}, "validated",
  {"validated", "ship"}, "shipped",
  {"source", "reject"} | {"optimized", "reject"} | {"validated", "reject"}, "rejected",
  _, "none"];
runTransitions[trace_] := Fold[transition, "source", trace];
maximumEvents = 8;
tracesByLength = Table[Tuples[events, length], {length, 0, maximumEvents}];
traces = Join @@ tracesByLength;
outcomes = runTransitions /@ traces;
shippingTraces = Pick[traces, outcomes, "shipped"];
expectedShipping = (# === {"optimize", "validate", "ship"} &) /@ traces;
actualShipping = (# === "shipped" &) /@ outcomes;

出力の各行は「機能、client必須か、静的出力のserver、静的出力のclient、サーバー実行のserver、サーバー実行のclient」の順です。`serverOnly` はソースの定義どおり、リクエスト時に動くサーバー機能として扱いました。

  capability === "pureRendering", True,

  And @@ ((deploymentCapabilityAllowed[mode, #] && componentPlacementAllowed[placement, #]) & /@ requirements);
rows = Table[Join[{capability, capabilityRequiresClient[capability]},
